author: dev_revs
body:
Hi guys, Introducing our new map, Alpine! Huge shoutout to {tag=a201086047354de0b9f31130961ea955} who did almost all of the building of the map, and also props to {tag=c9afb17da4f64a2486ac1d8e255c310e} for helping her out with her amazing builds. You may think, man that's pretty big for an 8v8 CTF, or it may not fit your "category", but this to me is what CTF is. A bigger map, which allows more stealth and possibility, not feeling the mid? sneak around through the Pine forest and try to sneak away with the flag. 2 arrow spawners on both bridges, and a gapple spawner at the gazebo area in the mid. You do spawn with minimal arrows, which could be a problem for players, so play smart. I'm planning on testing the map 8v8, if the map devs like it and accept it, and also if the officials accept it as a tourney map. When the XML is downloaded, I'll ask for it to be implemented in. Thanks {tag=47b15675a0484e8f863a0cbf86ba22dc} for hosting the server and {tag=3cef9279977f4a66ab7d42665d795a10} for making sure everyone stayed safe.

Map Creators: {tag=3feb57900603446c9bbfd5fb40759f41} {tag=a201086047354de0b9f31130961ea955} {tag=c9afb17da4f64a2486ac1d8e255c310e} {tag=3cef9279977f4a66ab7d42665d795a10}{tag=47b15675a0484e8f863a0cbf86ba22dc}
Main Builder: {tag=a201086047354de0b9f31130961ea955}
Server?: Profs build server
Gamemode?: Capture the Flag (Tournament) can be public, but made mainly for tournament

XML:  https://goo.gl/Tmx0dL
MAP:  https://goo.gl/YAAmY4
IMGUR: http://imgur.com/a/fOujs 
YOUTUBE VID: coming soon
Please post your comments below, constructive critism helps, instead of basic stuff. Hope you guys enjoy! First ever map posted, it was fun making it with my friends.
